svg.title: XPlanner: PM delegation from Bootstrap through Stage 19
svg.desc: PM coordinates and runs owner-authorized deployment tools without doing specialist verification. BA investigates; UX designs screens; Architect produces architecture, knowledge and SDD; Developer implements and verifies delivery. Fresh BA, QA, Architect and Developer sessions review the exact assigned scope. Checks 3, 12 and 18 belong to the responsible BA, Architect and Developer. The owner makes every required human decision. Session starts and totals are derived from the sequence, not a fixed permanent team.
svg.text: CONTINUATION: same PM, approved baseline, explicit specialist assignments
Owner accepts the slice. PM records the outcome and authorized next action.
Illustrative, not XPlanner agent execution history or evidence that all stages or the entire migration are complete.
